source.note: Read out of the application's own saved state with a generic protobuf field walk, not re-derived from the canonical ledger. All three saved states carry an identical transaction list, so the T03 repeat-import left the ledger unchanged. The saved files live in the temporary research directory only; these integers are the durable record.

protobuf_fields.note: Field numbers observed in the 0.86.0 container, enough to re-decode with any generic protobuf walker. The file is a zip whose data.portfolio member starts with the ASCII magic PPPBV1; the protobuf begins at byte 6, where field 1 is the format version (70).
protobuf_fields.4: portfolio (1 uuid, 2 name, 5 reference account uuid)
protobuf_fields.5: transaction (2 type, 9.1 epoch seconds, 10 currency, 11 amount in cents, 12 shares in 1e-8 units, 13 note, 14 security uuid, 15 unit: 1 type / 2 amount cents / 3 currency)

precision.note: The canonical ledger's 0.0123456789 DRIP shares store as 1234568 (8 decimals) and its 55.1566666667 sale settles as 5516 cents. The 0.0000000001 deposit stores as zero.

observed.note: Displayed values from docs/research/competitive/2026-08/observations.md. Drawdown and volatility are recorded but not reconciled; the B1 target is TWR and XIRR.

valuation_model.explanation: With no quote provider configured the application values a security at the gross price of its most recent transaction: net plus fees for a sale, net minus fees for a purchase, divided by the stored share count.
valuation_model.terminal_note: The report period runs from the first transaction to the run date, not to the last ledger date. Prices do not move after 2026-01-15, so TTWROR is unaffected, but the IRR annualization window is 228 days rather than 13.
